summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an Argentine relevant-event notice under CNV rules) disclosing open-market purchases of its own treasury shares. The company bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA on Nov 5, 2026, at an average AR$1,639.99 per share for total consideration of AR$196,799,983, settling Nov 11, 2026. Purchases stayed under the 25% cap on the prior 90-business-day average daily trading volume. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is stated; this is routine buyback reporting, not a special situation.
